stories.title: Nvidia gives Jensen Huang his job back, and the memes pour in
stories.summary: Eleven days after he resigned, Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Huang as CEO. Timelines filled with AI memes of his return, and Trump posted one of Huang raising a red bra in his Butler rally pose.

stories.title: ESPN viewers turn on the network over the arguing-couple segment
stories.summary: After the clip of Jesse Palmer narrating a couple's fight passed millions of views, some fans said ESPN went too far with two private people.
